mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases real borrowing costs and reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer spending and economic confidence, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST increased by ≥1% over the past month, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), weak labor market conditions suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO increased by ≥0.5% over the past month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,500,000 units annually, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL above their 12-month averages signal persistent inflation with monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are above 12-month averages, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In industrial contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100.0), declining manufacturing output signals economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
